verdict.rationale: Restate documents flow control that caps concurrent invocations per scope, aimed at controlling cost, protecting downstream services and keeping scheduling fair. Virtual-object sessions keyed by ID add built-in per-key concurrency control. However, nothing in the evidence shows time-based rate limits, and per-tenant scoping is only implied by the generic "per scope" wording. Missing for 10: documented request-rate limiting, explicit per-workflow/per-tenant scope configuration details, independent or hands-on corroboration of fairness under a hot tenant.
